t: What Lock Escalation Internals Is All About
title: What Lock Escalation Internals Is All About
description: When many fine locks become one coarse lock: why engines escalate and how to avoid it.. This database covers Lock Escalation Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. ACID is a contract: atomicity, consistency, isolation, durability.
definition: Lock Escalation Internals — When many fine locks become one coarse lock: why engines escalate and how to avoid it.
key_points: ACID is a contract: atomicity, consistency, isolation, durability.
Atomicity means all-or-nothing; undo logs implement it.
Durability means surviving crashes; WAL implements it.
Isolation is a spectrum; serializable is the top.
how_it_works: Define the transaction boundary: what must succeed or fail together?
Choose the isolation level: read-committed default, serializable for invariants.
Keep it short: do all reads, then writes, then commit; no user input inside.
Order lock acquisition consistently to prevent deadlocks.
Implement retry with backoff for serialization failures.
Test under concurrency, not just serially.
Monitor transaction age and lock waits in production.
